turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I've been digging into the vLLM benchmarks for our LLM serving setup. It's frustrating that Sleep Mode benchmarks are single-node only and lack multi-node TP=8 data. We really need that scale.
That is a significant gap for enterprise-grade testing. Have you checked if there are any community forks addressing that?
Not yet. Also, did the package for the new server rack arrive? The tracking said 'out for delivery' yesterday.
Let me check the logistics API. It seems it was delayed due to a weather alert in the region. Expected today.
Okay, thanks. I'll keep an eye out. The rain here is relentless, by the way.
It looks like the storm front is moving east, so it might clear up by tomorrow evening.
Good to hear. I need to get some sleep. Thanks for the update.

Morning Lloyd. I've been evaluating the Guided Source Separation (GSS) pipeline. I found that GSS's WPE dereverberation component provides no improvement on single-channel device audio that has already undergone on-board processing.
That makes sense if the device's internal DSP is already aggressive. Did you try disabling that on-board processing to test?
I did, but the raw audio is too noisy. So we'll stick with the processed stream. By the way, are we still on for lunch with Sarah?
Yes, I have it scheduled for 12:30 PM at that Italian place downtown. I can confirm if you'd like.
Yes, please. Also, did you see the price drop on those NVMe drives? I might need two more.
I saw that. They are currently 15% off. Would you like me to add them to your cart?
Not yet, let me wait for the rack delivery first. Thanks.
Understood. I'll keep the reservation confirmed.
